name: B2B Commerce — B2B & Wholesale Solution for WooCommerce — User Management, Tiered Pricing, Role-Based Access & More
author: softivus

sections.description:
B2B Commerce is a comprehensive WordPress plugin that transforms your WooCommerce store into a powerful B2B (Business-to-Business) platform. This complete solution enables businesses to manage wholesale operations, distributor networks, and multi-tier customer relationships with advanced pricing controls, user management, and approval workflows.

Perfect for:
* Wholesale businesses selling to retailers
* Manufacturers with distributor networks
* B2B distributors and resellers
* Companies with multiple customer tiers
* Businesses needing user approval systems
* Stores with complex pricing structures

Key Benefits:
* Complete B2B Solution – Everything you need to run a B2B business in one plugin
* Four Account Types – Manage different customer tiers with specific pricing and features
* Tiered Pricing System – Set quantity-based discounts that automatically apply
* User Approval System – Control who can access your B2B features
* Easy Setup – Get started in minutes with automatic page creation
* WooCommerce Integration – Works seamlessly with your existing store
* Free Demo Available – Test all features before you buy
* No Monthly Fees – One-time purchase, lifetime updates
* Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
* Developer Friendly – Clean code, hooks, and API support

Why Choose B2B Commerce?

  • Complete B2B Solution – Everything you need to run a B2B business in one plugin
  • Four Account Types – Manage different customer tiers with specific pricing and features
  • Tiered Pricing System – Set quantity-based discounts that automatically apply
  • User Approval System – Control who can access your B2B features
  • Easy Setup – Get started in minutes with automatic page creation
  • WooCommerce Integration – Works seamlessly with your existing store
  • Free Demo Available – Test all features before you buy
  • No Monthly Fees – One-time purchase, lifetime updates
  • Mobile Responsive – Works perfectly on all devices
  • Developer Friendly – Clean code, hooks, and API support

Four Account Types

1. B2B Customer – Standard business customers who need wholesale access
* Typical users: Small businesses, startups, independent retailers
* Benefits: Access to wholesale pricing, B2B-only products, business account features
* Pricing example: 10% discount on regular prices

2. Wholesale Customer – High-volume business customers with significant purchasing power
* Typical users: Large retailers, chain stores, established businesses
* Benefits: Higher discounts, priority support, exclusive products, tiered pricing
* Pricing example: 16% discount + tiered pricing for bulk orders

3. Distributor – Authorized distributors who resell products to other businesses
* Typical users: Regional distributors, authorized resellers, supply chain partners
* Benefits: Highest discounts, exclusive distributor products, reseller support
* Pricing example: 20% discount + special distributor pricing

4. Retailer – Traditional retail customers with limited wholesale access
* Typical users: Individual consumers, small retail shops, occasional buyers
* Benefits: Standard retail pricing, access to retail products, regular customer features
* Pricing example: Regular retail prices (no wholesale discounts)

Key Features

User Management System
* Complete B2B user registration with company information
* User approval workflow – approve or reject B2B applications
* Role-based access control for different customer types
* Bulk user import/export functionality
* User dashboard with personalized experience

Advanced Pricing Control
* Role-based pricing for different customer types
* Tiered pricing system with quantity-based discounts
* Percentage or fixed amount discounts
* Minimum quantity requirements
* Automatic price calculation and display

Product Visibility Control
* Control which products are visible to different user roles
* Category-based restrictions
* Wholesale-only products
* Product-level visibility settings

Order Management
* Track B2B orders separately from retail orders
* Order approval workflows
* Bulk order processing
* Order analytics and reporting

Email Notifications
* Automated email system for B2B communications
* Customizable email templates
* User approval/rejection notifications
* Order confirmation emails

Reporting & Analytics
* B2B sales performance tracking
* Customer analytics and insights
* User activity monitoring
* Export data for external analysis

Import/Export Tools
* Bulk user management
* Pricing rules import/export
* Order data export
* CSV template downloads

Shortcodes & Integration
* Easy integration with any page or post
* Registration forms
* User dashboards
* Product catalogs
* Pricing displays

Perfect For

  • Wholesale businesses selling to retailers
  • Manufacturers with distributor networks
  • B2B distributors and resellers
  • Companies with multiple customer tiers
  • Businesses needing user approval systems
  • Stores with complex pricing structures

Easy Setup Process

  1. Install & Activate – One-click installation through WordPress admin
  2. Automatic Setup – Plugin creates essential B2B pages automatically
  3. Configure Settings – Set up user roles, pricing rules, and approval settings
  4. Start Managing – Begin accepting B2B registrations and managing customers

Automatic Page Creation

When you activate B2B Commerce, it automatically creates:
* B2B Registration Page – Complete registration form for new B2B customers
* B2B Dashboard – Personalized dashboard for B2B customers
* Account Settings – Customer account management page

Tiered Pricing Example

Product: Industrial Widget (Regular Price: $50.00)

B2B Customer Pricing:
* 1-10 units: $45.00 each (10% discount)
* 11-50 units: $42.00 each (16% discount)
* 51-100 units: $40.00 each (20% discount)
* 100+ units: $38.00 each (24% discount)

Wholesale Customer Pricing:
* 1-10 units: $42.00 each (16% discount)
* 11-50 units: $38.00 each (24% discount)
* 51-100 units: $35.00 each (30% discount)
* 100+ units: $32.00 each (36% discount)

Distributor Pricing:
* 1-10 units: $40.00 each (20% discount)
* 11-50 units: $35.00 each (30% discount)
* 51-100 units: $30.00 each (40% discount)
* 100+ units: $25.00 each (50% discount)

Pro Features (B2B Commerce Pro)

Upgrade to B2B Commerce Pro for advanced features:
* Quote Management System – Complete quote request and approval workflow
* Product Inquiry System – Advanced product inquiry forms
* Bulk Pricing Calculator – Interactive calculator for complex orders
* Enhanced Email Notifications – Advanced email system with more templates
* Priority Support – Dedicated support channel
* API Integration – REST API for custom integrations
* Advanced Reporting – Detailed analytics and custom reports

Documentation & Support

  • Complete Documentation – Visit https://softivus.com/wp/b2b/ for detailed setup guides
  • Video Tutorials – Step-by-step video guides for configuration
  • FAQ Section – Frequently asked questions and answers
  • Community Support – Connect with other B2B Commerce users
  • Email Support – Direct support for plugin-related issues

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher (Required)
  • PHP 7.4 or greater (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater

Performance Optimized

  • Lightweight and fast
  • Optimized database queries
  • Caching support
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • SEO-friendly

Security Features

  • Secure user authentication
  • Role-based access control
  • Data encryption
  • CSRF protection
  • SQL injection prevention

Support

For support, documentation, and updates, visit https://softivus.com/wp/b2b/

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data. All data is stored locally on your WordPress installation. We respect your privacy and the privacy of your customers.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/b2b-commerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the B2B Commerce settings page to configure the plugin
  4. Create B2B user roles and set up pricing rules
  5. Start managing your B2B customers!
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes, B2B Commerce requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated. It extends WooCommerce’s functionality to add B2B features.

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes, B2B Commerce is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce. It uses standard WordPress and WooCommerce hooks.

How do I set up tiered pricing?

Go to B2B Commerce > Pricing Rules in your WordPress admin. Create rules for different user roles and set minimum quantities and discount amounts.

Can I control which products are visible to B2B customers?

Yes, you can set product visibility rules to show different products to different user roles. This is perfect for wholesale-only products.

How does the user approval system work?

When users register for B2B accounts, they are placed in “pending” status. You can approve or reject them from the User Management page.

Can I import existing customers?

Yes, B2B Commerce includes import/export functionality. You can import users via CSV and assign them to appropriate B2B roles.

Is there a limit on the number of B2B customers?

No, there are no limits on the number of B2B customers you can have. The plugin scales with your business.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit https://softivus.com/wp/b2b/ for information about B2B Commerce Pro features and pricing.

Is there support available?

Yes, we provide comprehensive support including documentation, video tutorials, and email support for the free version.
